details:
As a Film Maker, this feature is something I've needed for so long, something that could change how we could film make.

To all Film Makers of VRChat that have struggled to find people to help, don't you ever wish you could just do it all yourself? Sometimes only you have those ideas that is hard to explain to others.

In no offense to gathering people to body act for any project, there are those moments where you don't have enough people to help you film.

So what if there was a way where you could have a clone of yourself, or "Clones" of yourself.

Imagine this, being able to record your movements with an avatar for like a minute, hit some button and boom, a clone of you is placed in the world doing the same movements, toggles, and avatar actions for that whole minute it recorded. Not only that, you could clone yourself in that avatar as many times up to maybe like 20-40 times?

Expanding upon that, what if you could switch into different avatars, like as long as the avatar is in your favorites, you could switch to different ones and clone yourself avatars in your favorites.

In my own experience, my creative mind is limited by the amount of people I could gather for a recording session which forces me to lower my standards for scenes, but what if it wasn't? I know I'm not alone on this struggle.

Take for example creating a world building scene, you can't call in enough people so you would just clone yourself and populate the empty sections with clones of yourself in the same or different avatars.

And what about VRChat Delay? instead of having to deal with retaking shots over and over, you could decrease that amount by easily timing it with this feature, whether its interacting with other avatars or maybe a fight scene? this could easily be fixed.

IF this were added, I would expect something like allowing normal users to clones themselves up to 5-10 avatar clones at once, and VRC+ users would be able to place down 30 or 40 clones of themselves.

Maybe when creating an instance, there would be an option to turn on avatar clones or maybe call it a filming instance?

This could also inspire or bring in more film makers to the VRChat scene, get people to be more creative if they were in control of the avatars with there films.

I wrote this feature out before but I feel like I needed to rewrite it for people to better understand it.
title: VRC Avatar Clones Filming Feature
